title: Guitar session: Kahn, Ron Tototz, and friends
description: Four men gathered around a seated guitarist outside a wooden-framed building with woven matting walls and rolled reed blinds. Larry identifies Kahn, the company secretary, at right — he "walked funny, stiff legged like he had polio" — with Ron Tototz to Kahn's left.
larrysRecollection:
Right: Kahn, company secretary, walked funny, stiff legged like he had polio
left of Kahn is Ron Tototz
researchNotes: Identifications are Larry's own (Memories comment, 2026-08-13; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0003-c18006986.json). Both name spellings are phonetic. Part of the guitar-session series with VN-0007 and VN-0008.
